# File Drag and Drop

File Drag and Drop (4 pages): File Drag and Drop

## Chapters
- [File Drag and Drop](chapter_4338346757.md): File Drag and Drop SuiteApp lets you upload one or more files from your desktop to the file cabinet or a record page.
  - [Installing File Drag and Drop](section_4085008469.md): Prerequisite Before you install the File Drag and Drop SuiteApp, enable the following features by going to Setup Company Enable Features.
  - [Setting Up File Drag and Drop](section_4085008840.md): Set up the File Drag and Drop SuiteApp using the Setup Assistant.
  - [Using File Drag and Drop](section_4085009392.md): You can drag and drop one or more files from your desktop to the Drag and Drop-enabled file cabinet, or to a record or sublist line item.
